mission_07: Excellent! You have successfully extracted a comprehensive set of temporal features from a datetime column. You learned how to use pandas dt accessor for component extraction, create boolean flags for domain-specific periods, and apply cyclical encoding with sine/cosine transforms. Cyclical encoding is particularly important because it preserves the circular nature of time: hour 23 is closer to hour 0 than to hour 12. Temporal features are among the most powerful engineered features for time series forecasting, demand prediction, and any time-dependent analysis.
